label.purpose: Scope, state, table headers, counts, and numeric identifiers.

components.name: Source Card
components.description: The active working surface for source state, counts, and local workbook import.
components.html:
Source files

Choose one or more Garage 61 files to begin.

Drivers 00Full timed laps 00Warnings 00
components.css: .ds-source-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #182126; border-radius: 12px; background: #fbfaf5; color: #182126; box-shadow: 0 18px 42px -26px rgb(24 33 38 / 35%); padding: 46px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(46 90 168 / 6%) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(rgb(46 90 168 / 6%) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 32px 32px; } .ds-source-card h2 { margin: 0; font: 600 2rem/1.05 'Recursive Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-source-card p { color: #4d5a5e; font: 400 0.92rem/1.55 'Recursive Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-readout { display: flex; border-top: 1px solid #c9cbc2; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9cbc2; } .ds-readout span { flex: 1; padding: 14px 12px 14px 0; color: #6f7a7c; font: 500 0.63rem/1.2 'Fragment Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A measured secondary action on the paper surface.
components.css: .ds-outline-button { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid #182126; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #182126; font: 600 0.78rem/1 'Recursive Variable', sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-outline-button:hover { border-color: #2e5aa8; color: #2e5aa8; } .ds-outline-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2e5aa8; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Theme Button
components.description: A compact icon control that cycles System, Light, and Dark modes.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-button" aria-label="Theme: System. Switch to Light"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M8 21h8M12 17v4"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-button { display: inline-grid; width: 34px; height: 34px; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #939d9e; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #4d5a5e; } .ds-theme-button:hover { border-color: #2e5aa8; background: #e8e5dc; color: #2e5aa8; } .ds-theme-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2e5aa8; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-theme-button svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.8; }

components.name: Imported File Row
components.description: A full-width source row with facts, collapsed warnings, and a destructive remove action.
components.css: .ds-file-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 13px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9cbc2; } .ds-file-row strong { font: 600 0.78rem/1.2 'Recursive Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-file-row small, .ds-file-row summary { color: #6f7a7c; font: 500 0.59rem/1.4 'Fragment Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-file-row button { width: 30px; height: 30px; border: 1px solid #d84b2f; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #d84b2f; }

components.name: Analysis Tabs
components.description: A ruled index that keeps analysis views in one scope.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; border-top: 1px solid #939d9e; border-bottom: 1px solid #939d9e; } .ds-tabs button { position: relative; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #6f7a7c; font: 500 0.64rem/1 'Fragment Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { color: #182126; background: #fbfaf5; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"]::after { position: absolute; right: 14px; bottom: -1px; left: 14px; height: 2px; background: #d84b2f; content: ''; }

narrative.overview:
Stint Analyzer is a direct tool for source review and lap comparison. The interface uses paper-like surfaces, ruled data, compact labels, and a small set of useful state colors. It does not use decorative product codes, privacy badges, motorsport graphics, or promotional privacy copy as visual content.

Garage 61 names the supported workbook format. Stint Analyzer names the site.
keyCharacteristics: Mineral paper and dark graphite surfaces.
Useful icons for actions and states.
Paper texture and short analysis-panel color marks.
Tables and ruled rows instead of nested dashboard cards.
dos: Do use direct labels that explain the next task.
Do keep the paper texture and compact color marks as material signatures.
Do use icons when they explain an action, state, or evidence type.
Do keep Garage 61 as a source-format reference, not the site name.
donts: Don't show meaningless IDs, fake source codes, or decorative workflow numbering.
Don't use G61 or SA as a site mark.
Don't use repeated privacy marketing copy.
Don't add gradients, neon, racing stripes, carbon textures, or full-page grids.
